notes: Written after the shared web-search budget ran out, and direct page fetches were blocked by the sandbox egress policy, so every number comes from the writer kit fact table and the fact-check notes (Part 3.6); no new ASINs were used. Please re-check: (1) JD2 Model 32 handle about 36 in, 10-ton cylinder with 14 in stroke, and the 'square over 1-1/2 in / solid over 1 in needs hydraulics' limits (fact-check notes); (2) JD2 manual pressure figures (usually below 1,300 psi; 1-3/4 x .095 mild steel about 900 psi) - the notes label these 'Manual:' and I read that as the JD2 manual; confirm the context in M32BDirections.pdf; (3) JD2 hydraulic adapter kit listings conflict on whether the cylinder is included (stated in article as a conflict); (4) Rogue Fab M605 drive options (manual hydraulic, air-over-hydraulic, 1.5/2.0 HP electric-hydraulic) and about 94 deg per stroke; M605 wall conflict (.188 vs .250) stated as a conflict; (5) Woodward Fab WFB2-AHP air/hydraulic version (fact-check notes, not confirmed on Woodward's page by me); (6) Baileigh RDB-050 net weight 310 lb. Decision-table OD and volume bands are labelled in the article as rules of thumb. Left out: any comparative cost between air and electric kits, compressor CFM figures, cylinder-included status for Eastwood kits. Does not duplicate the home-garage roundup's picks; links to it via data-bhg-link.
